name: csedu-nexus
description: CSEDU Nexus - Student Organization Management System

scripts.dev: node switch-env.js local && concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: node switch-env.js production && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: node switch-env.js production && cd backend && npm start
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd frontend && npm install
